qs.s: Son ___ profonde est de voyager autour du monde.
qs.en: Her deepest longing is to travel around the world.

qs.s: Elle a finalement réalisé son ___ à trouver un foyer stable.

qs.en: He often talks about his ambitions for his future career.

qs.en: The doctor asked him to take a deep breath in before listening to his lungs.

qs.en: The slow inhalation of fresh air helps calm the heart rate.

qs.en: The surgeon used a tube for the suctioning of accumulated mucus.

qs.en: He has been passionate about photography since his adolescence.

qs.en: She framed a photograph of her parents taken on their wedding day.

qs.en: This organisation fights the exclusion of people with disabilities.
